Taekwondo Classes in Pantego, TX

The home dojang of Lone Star Institute of Taekwondo — proudly based in Pantego, training families from Pantego, Arlington, and across the DFW metroplex.

Our StudioOur ClassesThe Pantego Community
Our Home Studio

1541 S. Bowen Road, Pantego, TX 76013

The Only Studio With Our Full Program

Pantego is home base for Lone Star Institute of Taekwondo, and it's the only location that runs our complete curriculum: Little Ninjas (ages 3–5), Youth Classes (ages 6–17), Adult Classes (18+), and our Advanced track — sparring, board breaking, and competitive team training. For more than 15 years, this studio has been where Pantego families build discipline and confidence, class after class.

Founder and head instructor Master David Kestenbaum teaches here personally. A 7th Degree Black Belt trained under Grandmasters Won Chik Park, Roy D. Kurban, and Martin Hall, he was recognized at age 24 as one of the youngest Taekwondo Masters in the world, trained at the U.S. Olympic Training Center, and has earned over 500 competition trophies and medals across two decades. See our full instructional lineage.

Ages 3–5

Little Ninjas

Our youngest students build coordination, listening skills, and a strong voice through fun, age-appropriate drills — the foundation everything else is built on.

Ages 6–17

Youth Classes

Structured classes that build discipline, resilience, and real self-defense skills, with a clear path of belts and goals to keep kids and teens motivated year-round.

Learn More

Ages 18+

Adult Classes

Evening and daytime sessions built for adults training for fitness, stress relief, or practical self-defense — train solo or alongside your kids.

Sparring • Breaking • Competition

Advanced Classes

Only the Pantego studio runs our full advanced track — supervised sparring, board breaking, and a competitive team that trains under Master Kestenbaum for the Texas Karate League, Texas State Taekwondo Association, and USA Taekwondo.

Learn More

Proud to Call Pantego Home

Pantego is a small, tight-knit community surrounded by Arlington — and that's exactly what our studio feels like. Families walk in as strangers and leave as part of a training family that spans generations, built around Master Kestenbaum's own standards for discipline, respect, and consistency.

  • Rated 5/5 by 200+ students
  • Certified black belt instructors (1st–7th degree), recognized by the United States Taekwondo Grandmasters Society
  • Proud member of the Texas Karate League, Texas State Taekwondo Association, and USA Taekwondo
  • The only LSIT location with Little Ninjas through Advanced Competition Team, plus daytime classes

The Five Tenets of Taekwondo

예의

Courtesy

Ye-wee

Courtesy (예의, ye-wee) reminds us to show respect in the dojang and beyond through sincere etiquette and kindness.

염치

Integrity

Yom-chee

Integrity (염치, yom-chee) calls for honesty, strong morals, and the courage to do what is right even when it is difficult.

인내

Perseverance

Een-nay

Perseverance (인내, een-nay) is the willingness to keep pushing toward every goal despite obstacles in training or life.

극기

Self Control

Gook-gee

Self control (극기, gook-gee) keeps thoughts, emotions, and actions in balance so we can respond with a steady mind and body.

백절불굴

Indomitable Spirit

Baekjool Boolgool

Indomitable spirit (백절불굴, baekjool boolgool) is to be defeated a hundred times yet never bent — the heart of true strength.
